title: Infinitely Many Perfect Numbers
exact_target: Are there infinitely many positive integers equal to the sum of their proper positive divisors, including both parity classes?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 1248 (NT-041). CC BY 4.0.
